name: Impression Ladies Salon Al Karama
address: Shop 3, R 444 Wasl Properties Bldg - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
owner_description: Impression Beauty Salon located in Al Karama, Dubai . The salon offers services like hairdressing, hair color, permanent Hair extensions, Eyelashes extensions, beauty and spa treatments. We also offer hair spa services, waxing, mehendi, manicures, pedicures, gel nail polish,Nail Extensions, hair treatments for hair loss/anti dandruff, Keratin and Botox hair treatments among many others.

reviews.text:

reviews.author: Tinu Chandy
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience at Impression Beauty Salon. I first had my eyebrows threaded and a pedicure by Ms. Selina, and both the services exceeded by expectations. She shaped my eyebrows exactly the way I wanted, and the pedicure was incredibly relaxing. She was very patient and thorough in removing all the dead skin, and the foot massage afterward was so soothing. Her attention to detail and gentle approach made the whole experience truly enjoyable.
I also got my hair colored by Ms. Gloria, who did an excellent job. She was professional, friendly, and made sure I was comfortable throughout the process. The head massage during the hair wash was one of the most relaxing parts of my visit.
Overall, it was a very pleasant and refreshing experience. The staff were warm, skilled, and attentive. I would definitely recommend Impression Beauty Salon and will be happy to visit again!
reviews.owner_reply: Thank you so much for your wonderful review! 🌸 We're delighted to know you enjoyed our services and experienced the warm hospitality of our team. Your kind words mean the world to us and inspire us to keep delivering our very best. We can't wait to welcome you back soon!

reviews.author: Zee Jetha
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience at the salon today! I went in for a manicure which was done by BABY she has magic in her hands, pedicure, and a Korean hair spa by LAXMi she was amazing, and everything was absolutely perfect.

The staff were extremely professional, friendly, and attentive throughout my visit, and not  forgetting Josephina who served me a delicious coffee with love and care 😊. My manicure and pedicure were done with great care and precision, and my nails look beautiful and well-groomed. The Korean hair spa was the highlight of my visit — it was incredibly relaxing and left my hair feeling soft, nourished, and healthy.

The salon was clean, comfortable, and had a very calming atmosphere, which made the whole experience even more enjoyable. I truly appreciated the attention to detail and the excellent service provided by the team.

Highly recommend this salon to anyone looking for quality treatments and a relaxing self-care experience. I will definitely be coming back!
